2.50pm "It's nice to get the job done," Mitchell says. "Nothing changes for me, I am used

strike to me. I would take them anyway they come. I love the game, I love competing 
and it was nice to get the job done"

for 3 as their sloppy fielding, for the second successive game, let New Zealand off the

Zealand past 300. It won't be an easy chase even though the pitch looks to have eased
